resume: Multi-engine firmware: thirteen engines with factory presets, four tracks (8 shared voices), a 64-step sequencer, effects, a modulation matrix, USB and TRS MIDI, and USB audio. The full manual is in the repository wiki.

commandes.role: Octave down; on action pages, dialogs and the menu: back. With OCT+ at the same time, octave reset to zero.
Octave up; on action pages, dialogs and the menu: confirm. With OCT- at the same time, octave reset to zero.
Effects and SLICER; a second press goes to the next page. Held: performance effects, mutes on the black keys.
Scale and chord keys. Held, a key sets the root note.
Engine parameters. Held, a white key selects the engine.
Mixer, global settings and system. Held: mute, solo, tap tempo, levels on KNOB 1 to 4.
Presets, user sounds, projects. Held: undoes the last load (again: redoes it).
Arpeggiator; it blinks on the beat.
Sequencer: steps and pattern. Held: Song, which chains patterns.
Starts and stops the four tracks.
Arms the track for recording, on all pages. When stopped, it also starts playback.
Tempo (BPM); the MENU > BPM LOCK setting freezes it.
Track sound, on HOME and on SAVE > PRESETS.
Selects track T1 to T4, on all pages.
Play the selected track, from F3 to G5. On the STEP page, they enter notes (drum tracks: step grid).

gestes: GLO held + SELECT: tempo, even with BPM LOCK.
GLO held + PLAY: restarts from the beginning.
OCT- and OCT+ together: octave reset to zero.
a_savoir: These controls come from the repository's controls image (docs/controls.jpg); the README points to the wiki for details.
A second calculation path (2ND CORE) is in beta and disabled by default: MENU > SYSTEM > 2ND CORE.
